records.people: Nadezhda Yermakova (chaired the National Bank of Belarus 2011-2014)
records.move: from chair of the National Bank of Belarus (2011-2014) to head of the board of directors of Belgazprombank OJSC (appointed 15 January 2021)
records.summary: The report says Yermakova chaired the board of Belarusbank and then the National Bank of Belarus in 2011-2014, and was appointed head of Belgazprombank's board of directors on 15 January 2021, having run the bank's interim administration from 15 June to 11 December 2020. Ownership is stated and mixed: the same page names Russian Gazprom PJSC and Gazprombank JSC as holders of 49.66% each, Gazprom Transgaz Belarus 0.49% and the Republic of Belarus, through its Ministry of Energy, 0.097%.

records.people: Noura Abdulaziz Al Suwaidi (Chief Operating Risk Officer at the Qatar Central Bank)
records.move: from Risk Management Officer at Edaa (2021-2023) and Chief Operating Risk Officer of the Qatar Central Bank to nominee for independent board membership of Lesha Bank
records.summary: Lesha Bank's own list of nominee biographies for independent and non-independent board membership states that Noura Abdulaziz Al Suwaidi is the Chief Operating Risk Officer at the Qatar Central Bank, and gives her earlier post as Risk Management Officer at Edaa from 2021 to 2023. She appears in the document as a nominee for an independent board seat, so the central bank post and the bank board seat overlap. Ownership is settled by Lesha Bank's 2023 annual report, which gives its Qatar Stock Exchange listing and names private shareholders above 5%.
records.source_title: Biographies of the Nominees for Independent and Non Independent Board Membership of Lesha Bank (Lesha Bank)
records.quote: Ms. Noura Abdulaziz Al Suwaidi is the Chief Operating Risk Officer at the Qatar Central Bank.
records.second_source_quote: a listed entity on Qatar Stock Exchange (QSE: QFBQ)

records.people: Joaquin Alonso Vazquez (Ministro Presidente del Banco Central de Cuba from February 2023)
records.move: from vice president of the Banco Popular de Ahorro (seven years, to 2017) and president of CADECA S.A. to Minister President of the Banco Central de Cuba
records.summary: The article reports his appointment as Ministro Presidente del Banco Central de Cuba, announced 16 February 2023, replacing Martha Sabina Wilson Gonzalez. It lists his earlier posts as president of CADECA S.A., the state currency-exchange entity, several roles at the state Banco Popular de Ahorro (provincial deputy director in Havana, director of savings, director of credits and vice president for seven years to 2017) and vice president of CUBALSE for economic and financial activity. Every employer named is a Cuban state entity, so this is filed as a public-sector move.
records.source_title: Joaquin Alonso Vazquez, nuevo Ministro Presidente del Banco Central de Cuba (Directorio Cubano)
records.quote: Vicepresidente de CUBALSE para atender la actividad economica y financiera

records.people: Marakon Alilee (appointed to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu board, 12 September 2014)
records.move: from Director General of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Industry and Tourism, and earlier senior posts at the Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce, Airports Vanuatu Limited, VANAIR and the Vanuatu National Provident Fund, to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu board
records.summary: The Reserve Bank's own press release on its 12 September 2014 board appointments says Alilee holds the position of Director General of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Industry and Tourism, and lists earlier senior executive posts in government ministries and statutory bodies including the Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce, Airports Vanuatu Limited, VANAIR and the Vanuatu National Provident Fund. It gives no dates. Jimmy Nipo was re-appointed in the same release; his background is given as the New Zealand High Commission and Director General of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. No bank, insurer or investment firm is named for either man, so this is filed as a public-sector move.
records.source_title: Press Release 06 2014: Board Appointments (Reserve Bank of Vanuatu)
records.quote: He holds the current position of the Director General of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Industry and Tourism.
